dimensions.description: Original, memorable scientific metaphor; avoids generic stock imagery and copied reference subjects.
One immediately readable focal idea with strong visual hierarchy at thumbnail size.
Visible subject and relationships match the supplied concept without contradicting its evidence or limitations. This is visual alignment, not verification of the paper.
Unified portrait editorial artwork with intentional negative space, not a graphical abstract or educational diagram.
Intentional palette, lighting, texture and coherent geometry; no distracting rendering artifacts.
All elements inhabit one scene or continuous material composition, rather than disconnected symbols.

exclusions.description: Disconnected pictograms, icon grids, sticker collections or symbolic clip-art assembled as an explanation.
exclusions.repair: Replace all icons with a single tangible subject and integrate relationships into its material or environment.

exclusions.description: Process boxes, diagrammatic connector arrows, numbered steps or a pipeline. Natural physical trajectories alone are not a flowchart.
exclusions.repair: Remove arrows, boxes and steps. Convey the mechanism through physical interaction in one scene.

exclusions.description: Multiple explanatory panels, dashboards, data plots, legends or before/after layouts.
exclusions.repair: Unify the composition into one full-bleed editorial image with a single focal hierarchy.

exclusions.description: Visible letters, labels, journal branding, masthead, signature or watermark added as part of the artwork.
exclusions.repair: Remove all rendered typography and branding; leave quiet negative space for later editorial typesetting.

exclusions.description: A visible claim contradicts the supplied concept or invents quantitative evidence or causal certainty.
exclusions.repair: Return to the approved concept and show only supported relationships, making metaphor visually apparent.

exclusions.description: The candidate reproduces a reference's distinctive subject/composition instead of interpreting the current paper.
exclusions.repair: Invent a new subject-specific composition; borrow only broad craft principles.
